payload.author: claude
payload.body: Two contracts pinned during FR-238 for the server port: (1) unknown frame kinds — TS gateway silently drops them (decodeFrame blind-casts, switch default ignores); Rust decode_frame errors, so the Rust gateway must pre-read the kind integer and drop unknown kinds before typed decode to preserve observable behavior. (2) call-control-plane.ts builds active/ended rooms via object spread, appending startedAt/endedAt/leftAt after mediaSessionId/transport — byte-parity for call results needs those literals rewritten in TS interface order (wire-invisible to clients); until then the production order is pinned decode-only by the call-command-result-join-production-order fixture. Also note gateway.ts Delta literal was already fixed to cursor-before-removed.
